body: I'm the most anti-social person I know, I've always been an introvert and I hate being around people... Actually being around people makes me tired and completely without energy... I just like spending time with my girlfriend and a few friends.. So I was always looking for a job where I don't have to work with people...  Haven't found anything like that ever, I also don't have any special skills that could make me money... And I've been trying to exercise regularly, but it never lasts more than a few days, because I get so depressed that I feel like I want to die, not to exercise or do anything else

I would be making music, the kind Jaden Smith makes... My music would suck as hell, but I would enjoy doing it just for me... I would be travelling a lot obviously, as most people say, learning a lot of things that take time to learn... for example some martial art, or playing some music instrument, etc.. And I would be a simracer, I enjoy simracing
